items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Well, we would all play together.

ctx.x: I think I did once a little with T, but not while he was having a band. You see, his home was Muskogee and so what he would do
is he would maybe be gigging and me and Foots and Foots had a brother, Joe Thomas--I don't know if you heard of him.
